input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: open-tennis-robots flagship row 6: a contact-time survey on the board's calibration drill, as the ESC-lag survey

errors.what: First board survey used refine=0 (copied from the ESC-lag survey) and picked an instant take on a 6 ms build
errors.fix: traced to ~60x larger fit misses without the tau refinement; the take survey keeps the refinement

errors.what: A new stroke cut 11 of 12 surveys at the calibration drill's 4 s interval
errors.fix: the Pi holds each calibration ball until the board's take-survey count rises (cap TAKE_WAIT_S 8 s)

errors.what: Planned held-out check on seed 8 reproduced seed 7 to the digit (noise-free plants ignore the seed)
errors.fix: held-out check rerun at wheel lag 0.6 s instead

doc_friction.issue: MODES list seeds (7,) for the noise-free plants as if they mattered; on those plants the seed changes nothing, which cost a 45-minute run to learn
the status paragraph is one ~25,000-character line; appending to it is the only option and it is unreadable for an LLM or a person

deviations.why: no venture-level marketing page edit; the work is firmware on an unbuilt robot and index.html makes no claim it changes
deviations.did: updated llms.txt and the firmware README instead

notes: Board-side contact-time survey (SURVEY_TAKE 0x15 / TAKE_SURVEY 0x84, config TAKE_US), Pi advice with a 0.6 rms margin. Lag 0.3 s sweep: half-sine picks within 1 ms; 4/6 instant builds picked 1.5-2.5 ms and read worse told -> margin. Held-out at lag 0.6 s: margin advised 0/6 instant, 6/6 six-ms (sd 0.77->0.21%, spin 2.53->0.76%), 0/6 front-loaded (told unmargined: worst spin 5.03%). Verification: run_venture_tests.py open-tennis-robots and venture-preflight, output summarised in the PR.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: firmware survey + protocol + host advice + two 24-build simulator sweeps and write-up, senior embedded engineer estimate

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
